_readme: Per-run monitoring log, one file per calendar day (America/Phoenix), used to generate the Daily PDF Report. Distinct from cases.json, which is the permanent case/review-queue index.
_run_note: Fifty-fourth scheduled run, and the first under the chart Damon supplied on 2026-11-25 (277 records, 275 matchable names against 273 before). NO NEW FINDINGS: zero matches without an existing case across 10,482 product pages on 16 serving URLs. THE NEW CHART'S EFFECT WAS EXACTLY THE ONE PREDICTED AND NO MORE. "Incandescence", added as Pending on 2026-11-25, matched exactly one listing anywhere on the roster: Redland Ranch's "Incandescence(TM)", which is REDLANDRAN-031 -- the listing that seller retitled the same day. It is the same URL, already carried by that case, so no second case was created and the case number is unchanged; Redland's match count went 49 -> 50 for this reason alone. Both of that listing's titles are now chart names with different statuses: "Inkandeszenz" Registered, "Incandescence" Pending. The case keeps the name it was opened on and the match is recorded in its history. "Debutant", added the same day, matched NOTHING on any site -- an honest null, recorded so it is not re-checked as an open question. Ergonzi served on the first attempt, ending four resets in six runs. Xavian's Roses was refused for a sixth consecutive run; 9 cases unchecked, dates held.
